items.prompt: At node(i,j), where j counts up moves, which old next-row entries feed continuation?

options.why: That would discard the up-child state.
The up child increases the up-count to j+1, not j-1.

options.text: Next[j] for down and next[j+1] for up.
options.why: Down leaves the up-count unchanged; up increments it.

options.text: Current-row entries already overwritten at every index.
options.why: Continuation must use the child values from the later grid date.

items.explanation: Down leaves the up-count unchanged; up increments it.
